name: note-bubble
title: Note bubble
description: A non-modal bubble beside one card where the person writes, edits or removes the card's note, or reads a sent one. It points at its card with an arrow in the card's colour, draws above the board and moves nothing (README picks 5, 11-12; mockup 05 section 1).

files.core: note-bubble-core.ts (placeBubble, titleAnchor, bubbleView, saveIntent, isDirty, cancelIntent, NOTE_DISCARD_EVENT, NoteDiscardDetail; no DOM)
files.template: note-bubble-template.ts (noteBubbleTemplate: the only place the markup is built)
files.styles: note-bubble.css (scoped by the tag; tokens only)

parts.vb-nb-head: the card's number chip (vb-nb-num) and the head line (vb-nb-title): 'Note on 42', 'Edit note on 42', or 'Note 2 on 42, sent'; on a whole container no chip and 'Note on container Review' (3_FE_04 ruling 3)
parts.vb-nb-text: the textarea, 'Note text', up to MAX_TEXT characters; a sent note shows vb-nb-read (Markdown) instead
parts.vb-nb-error: role=alert, under the text: why the last save did not go through
parts.vb-nb-row: Remove (edit only), the key hint (vb-nb-hint), Cancel or Close, and Add note or Save (vb-nb-primary)

attributes.role: dialog (set by show); not modal: the board stays usable
attributes.data-side: right | left | below: where it opened beside the card (set by place)
attributes.data-phase: idle | saving | error (set by setPhase); aria-busy while saving
attributes.--kind: the card's kind colour, for the border and the arrow (set by show through the CSSOM); on a whole container, the container's line colour (show's `line`)
attributes.data-on: container: the bubble is about a container's title line, placed from titleAnchor; its edge follows the frame's line, fainter at rest (set by show)
attributes.--arrow: where the arrow meets the bubble's edge (set by place)

methods.show(v: BubbleView, card: { kind, number: draws it from noteBubbleTemplate; `line` (a container's regionColour) in place of kind and number for a note on a whole container
methods.place(p: Placement): left, top, data-side and --arrow from placeBubble, in its offset parent's pixels
methods.setPhase(phase, message?): saving disables the buttons and reads 'Saving…'; error shows the message and keeps the text
methods.focusText(): focus into the text with the caret at the end; a sent note's first button
methods.dirty (getter): whether the words typed differ from those show() drew (isDirty: line endings and surrounding whitespace do not count); always false for a sent note. The page reads it before opening another bubble over this one (3_FE_04 step 4G ruling 4)

events: vb-note (bubbles): detail { choice: 'save' | 'cancel' | 'remove', text }; Enter in the text is save, Esc anywhere is cancel. A cancel is sent only while the text is unchanged

vb-note-discard (bubbles): detail { text }; Esc or Cancel with changed text (cancelIntent 'ask'), in place of the cancel. The bubble stays open: the page asks "Discard your changes?" through its confirm dialog, then closes it (OK) or puts focus back with focusText (Cancel)
whenToUse: Writing, changing or reading the person's note on one card.
whenNotToUse: Questions that block the whole page (use the confirm dialog), or anything not about one card.
accessibility: role=dialog, labelled by its head line, not modal. Focus moves into the text when it opens and back to the card when it closes. Enter saves, Shift+Enter adds a line, Esc cancels (with changed text, the page asks first). Every button is a real button with a visible label and a focus ring.
